method: Re-read the local full-text audit/finding records, preserve their counterevidence, separate data/causal requirements, and rank by executable information gained per cost. This is a desk-based selection, not an independent source replication.

hypotheses: file position causally changes defect detection for at least some defect classes
apparent position associations are explained by default order, attention, complexity, or post-review proxy bias
leads.novelty_boundary: Position effects and at least one defect-specific controlled result pre-exist; broad novelty rejected.
leads.smallest_informative_test: Randomize file order in a consenting review team; log actual files viewed/time; blind-adjudicate seeded and naturally found defects by type.
leads.feasibility: requires collaboration and human subjects/review-team access

hypotheses: specific supply-chain controls lower independently verified incident/reachability rates
adoption metrics do not predict outcomes after exposure, ecosystem, and threat-model controls
leads.novelty_boundary: Existing studies are descriptive/reported outcome studies; do not infer control efficacy.
leads.smallest_informative_test: Longitudinal matched or randomized control rollout with verified incident outcomes and release/deployment denominators.
leads.feasibility: no suitable outcome dataset established; external coordination

hypotheses: a formally accounted private dependence screen improves utility at fixed directed inference leakage under shift
screen errors/shift destroy any gain or the screen adds cost without privacy-utility improvement
leads.novelty_boundary: Private dependence testing and directed CPL are prior art; central-DP screen and LDP release must compose and remain separate. Full-text counterevidence includes an ICML 2023 active membership attack under its malicious-server model and studied LDP mechanisms; this narrows any gap to an explicitly aligned threat/utility/composition setting and does not refute LDP in general.
leads.smallest_informative_test: First implement a declared composition/threat model; compare uniform, MI/Pearson, private screen, and oracle allocation on synthetic multi-attribute data under held-out shift and asymmetric attacks, including a malicious-server membership attack where applicable.
leads.feasibility: possible as a simulation, but substantial mechanism/accounting work; public multi-attribute benchmark not yet secured
leads.status: hold pending formal accounting/data audit and exact benchmark threat-model alignment

hypotheses: regime checks/fallback prevent underestimation outside an approximate filter's assumptions at bounded tightness cost
existing accountants already guard the regime or high-precision tests find no relevant underestimation
leads.novelty_boundary: Underlying validity caveat is established; no novel mathematical claim. Need exact published proof and implementation/source pinning.
leads.smallest_informative_test: Reproduce the paper's sequence example; enumerate heterogeneous mechanism and subsampling regimes against a high-precision privacy-loss distribution and a valid multi-order RDP accountant; test declared fallback.
leads.feasibility: local compute feasible after pinning exact assumptions/code; theoretical care required

selected_next_experiment.reason: A reproducible source/build, container harness, raw paired outputs, and a bounded falsifiable proxy study already exist. A fresh preselected seed block gives immediate independent seed-level challenge at low compute cost. If null, down-rank it and move to a more expensive 158/157 implementation audit.
limitations: outside findings 155-158 but consistent with explore-beyond-leads instruction
does not evaluate Paper 3 forecasting or Paper 4 utility
query-pair completion is not distinct bug yield
prior effect motivated the directional replication and remains exploratory
